caseName: Fidelity Union Casualty Co. v. Hanson
caseNameFull: Fidelity Union Casualty Co. v. Hanson
attorneys: Mr. John Neethe for petitioner. No appearance for respondents.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Texas denied, upon the ground that the judgment sought here to be reviewed is joint and the record fails to disclose summons and severance. Hartford Accident Indemnity Co. v. Bunn, 285 U. S. 169; Capital National Bank v. Board of Supervisors, 286 U. S. 550.
